name: @marketnow/trust-core
description: UTA Verification Core — the full agent-trust stack in one zero-dependency package: 12-stage verification pipeline, Ed25519 (RFC 8032) + JCS (RFC 8785) canonicalization, proof-of-possession, behavioral baselines with statistical drift detection (7 signal classes), capability graph with org policies (ALLOW / REQUIRE_APPROVAL / BLOCK + approval workflow), multi-tool attack-chain detection (AC-001..007) with data-flow graphs and trajectory risk scoring, cross-agent delegation gates, memory poisoning detection, Merkle transparency log with signed tree heads (RFC 6962-style), TFP-1.0 tool fingerprinting with drift reports, and evidence-first findings with confidence scoring. Every release is exercised by a registry-installed smoke suite (21/21). Zero runtime dependencies.
author: AliceLabs LLC <info@alicelabs.site>
